2014_spells.remove-curse.description: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner's attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded.
2014_spells.remove-curse.effectSummary: Move a creature or object a short distance
2014_spells.remove-curse.fullDescription: Using 1 action, at your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner's attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
